violation_type.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Report Suspected Child Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation (26 TAC §744.1201(5))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers - Report Suspected Child Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on information obtained, a staff member was informed of suspected abuse and did not report it.

finding_variants.text: Based on information obtained, a staff member was informed of suspected abuse and did not report it.
A child in care made outcries of suspected abuse, and the employees of the operation failed to notify DFPS.
Based on information reviewed during a DFPS investigation it was determine that the director did not report suspected sexual abuse of children within the required 24-hour timeframe.
